folderImport.importFailed: Import failed: {error}. Completed books remain in library.
folderImport.title: Import Folder
folderImport.subtitle: Choose a system folder to automatically find EPUB files and organize them into library folders by directory. Reads only; does not modify original files.
folderImport.unsupported: Folder selection is not supported in this environment. You can select multiple files using "Import Books", but directory hierarchy will not be preserved.
folderImport.intro: Scanning reads file and folder names only, not book text. Review once before importing; you can stop at any time and completed books are kept.
folderImport.flattened: Deep directories flattened: the shelf keeps a single level, with parent directories in folder names, e.g. "Category · Subcategory".
folderImport.grouping.auto.hint: Each directory becomes a shelf folder
folderImport.grouping.single.hint: All books go into a single folder of the same name
folderImport.grouping.none.hint: Import books only without creating folders
folderImport.existing.fill.hint: Leave books already in folders untouched (recommended)
folderImport.existing.replace.hint: Move existing books to match directories
folderImport.unresolved.other: {count} folders match multiple existing shelf folders with the same name. Please choose destinations.
folderImport.unresolved.one: {count} folder matches multiple existing shelf folders with the same name. Please choose a destination.
folderImport.duplicatesNote: Book counts are candidate estimates. Duplicates are identified by content during import; progress, notes, bookmarks, and favorites are preserved.
folderImport.settling: Finishing current batch, then stopping. Completed books are kept.
folderImport.done.cancelled: Import stopped. Completed books remain in library.
folderImport.done.failed: Import incomplete. Completed books remain in library.
folderImport.unreadable: {count} directories could not be read; preview includes accessible items only.
folderImport.issue.folderDeleted: Target folder was deleted; book imported but unfiled
folderImport.issue.categoryChanged: Book category changed during import; new category preserved
folderImport.issue.multipleSources: Same book found in multiple directories; earlier source used ({file})
folderImport.issue.stopped: Import stopped; book imported but unfiled
